Has IV self-administration teaching been completed?

About how far does the patient walk independently (at least 100 ft)? A PT note would help.
Any history of suicidal ideation, hallucinations, psychiatric diagnosis, conservatorship or FSP?
Is the patient on any isolation precautions?
